# Younic-Workspace-Report

> A single-file PHP app for creating daily work plans and exporting them as
> single-page PDFs. Plans are persisted as JSON; PDFs are rendered on demand
> by headless Chrome.

A work plan has: a date, a "Prepared by" name, an "Approved by" name, and a
list of tasks. Each task has a title and a status (`pending` or `done`).
Reports are exported as a one-page A4 PDF whose CSS scale factor is chosen
based on the number of tasks so the entire report always fits on a single
sheet.

## Key files

- [generate_plan.php](generate_plan.php) — the entire app: routing, form,
  JSON storage, HTML report template, and headless-Chrome PDF generation.
- [README.md](README.md) — how to run the app.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE) — MIT.

## Features

- Create / save work plans (no accounts, no database — JSON files on disk).
- Open an existing plan to update task status (Pending / Done).
- Export a plan as a single-page PDF.
- List, edit, and delete existing reports from the home page.
- Strict one-page PDF output via a CSS `var(--scale)` that adapts to the
  number of tasks.

## Running

```bash
php -S 127.0.0.1:8000 generate_plan.php
```

Requires PHP 8.0+ and a headless Chrome / Chromium binary on `PATH`.

## Endpoints (form actions, all `POST` to `generate_plan.php`)

- `action=save` — create or overwrite a plan; expects `date`, `prepared_by`,
  `approved_by`, and a `tasks[]` array.
- `action=update` — update task statuses for an existing plan; expects `id`
  and `status[index]=pending|done`.
- `action=delete` — delete a plan and its cached PDF; expects `id`.

## URL parameters

- `?plan=<id>` — load a plan in the editor.
- `?plan=<id>&markdown=1` — generate and download the plan as a PDF.
